supersedes: 1.0 (phase1_freeze, OR-Tools GLS) -- kept frozen and runnable as a baseline

search.randomness: seeded -- identical routes for the same input, seed and stop rule on any machine (E5)

stopping.note: Both limits count iterations, not seconds, so the result does not depend on machine speed. Chosen in E6: best gap on all 5 test instances (50-800 customers) among six deterministic rules.

distance_convention.note: Unchanged from v1.0. Every edge given to PyVRP comes from distance.build_distance_matrix; pyvrp.read() and its own rounding are not used.

fleet_rule: max_vehicles is supplied by the caller per run, never inferred from the file name. If no feasible plan exists for that fleet, the result stays INFEASIBLE and carries a fleet_diagnosis (vehicles actually needed).
